title: Low-rate smartphone videoscopy for microsecond luminescence lifetime imaging with machine learning
summary: Methods/Results §§2–4: smartphone V-chopper and CNN classify video frames into gated/ungated samples, enabling microsecond luminescence lifetime imaging at 30 fps; proof-of-concept uses Eu dyes/paper substrate, not clinical validation. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
